title: Email/query SMTP path is inline in route_method rather than a handler module
description: Every other JMAP method in route_method delegates immediately to a dedicated function (handle_mailbox_get, handle_mailbox_set, handle_mailbox_query, etc.). The Email/query arm for special (SMTP) mailboxes is ~45 lines of inline DB query + pagination logic directly in the match arm (server.rs lines 573-617), rather than in crate::email::query. This breaks the established pattern: adding pagination parameters, sort options, or filtering to SMTP mailbox query requires editing server.rs rather than the email module. It also makes the inline logic untestable without spinning up a full server.
